# HATHOR Developers docs

> OpenSource HATHOR `developers` documentation map (HATHOR-* IDs). Operator CLI: `hath0r`. Hidden root: `.hath0r/` only — never `.hath0r/`.

## CANON
- [HATHOR-CANON-007 — HATHOR Developer & Role Guides Index](./INDEX.md): Human index for the developer documentation tree.

## GUIDE
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-011 — Agent Integrator Guide](./agent-integrator.md): Interact with HATHOR via hath0r CLI, AGENTS.md, docs indexes, and .hath0r/ layout (CLI 0.2 shipped surface + target domains).
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-012 — Bot Developer Guide](./bot-developer.md): Build single-role micro-bots for the HATHOR platform under the HATHOR operating model.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-013 — DevOps & DVO Guide](./devops-dvo.md): Environments, containers, telemetry spool/drain under .hath0r/, and authorized promotions for HATHOR.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-014 — Platform Engineer Guide](./platform-engineer.md): Build the HATHOR CLI (hath0r), chassis, orchestration bots, validation fabric, and Control Tower API.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-030 — QA/Test Engineer Guide](./qa-test-engineer.md): Exercise HATHOR validation altitudes, refuse bad claims, keep promotion evidence honest via hath0r.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-031 — Product Manager Guide](./product-manager.md): Shape HATHOR work through tickets, planes of authority, and evidence-backed outcomes without bypassing gates.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-032 — Release Manager Guide](./release-manager.md): Ticket-authorized, gate-enforced promotion along the HATHOR environment path without skipping stages.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-033 — Security & Compliance Officer Guide](./security-compliance-officer.md): Use HATHOR gates, zero-secret invariants, and knowledge trust tiers as mechanical controls.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-034 — Technical Writer Guide](./technical-writer.md): Author hathor-doc@1 corpus docs, keep IDs stable, align docs with Knowledge Plane trust under .hath0r/.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-035 — Engineering Manager Guide](./engineering-manager.md): Run HATHOR delivery through tickets, gates, validation altitudes, and honest promotion without heroics.
- [HATHOR-GUIDE-036 — UX/Design Guide](./ux-design.md): Shape HATHOR agent/CLI experiences around envelopes, gates, trust tiers, and honest degradation.
